manifest.sourceMode: committed Git tree with listed exclusions; no working-tree substitutions; pack documents additionally copied to archive root

excludedSourceFiles.reason: Historical source-pack input; retained in Git, omitted from current export to avoid nested obsolete packs.

manifest.authority: Newest explicit owner decisions, then current pack decisions; snapshot proves implementation, not design approval.

verification.status: merged; fresh physical DualSense and owner Makko acceptance remain pending
verification.implementationStatusChange: PR #64 moved from reviewed implementation to merged main. The merge and reviewed source trees are byte-identical; the previous canonical pack represented merged PR #63.

implementation.sharedCrossControl: Cross/Xbox A performs the normal variable-height jump outside Rhythm Mode and one beat attack per press inside Rhythm Mode. Held-button transitions require release; the old default Square-beat save migrates once while deliberate custom mappings and controller preferences remain.
implementation.platformDescent: Down plus the mapped jump drops through only the current platform, including an orderly Rhythm Mode exit. The next platform catches the player, the street remains solid and held chords do not chain-drop.
implementation.hackNotice: The persistent multi-state HACK panel is replaced by a contextual HACK READY notice only when the grounded, charged player has a usable target. It holds 1.8 seconds, fades for 0.6 seconds and does not loop while readiness persists.
implementation.worldPolish: The sky covers rooftop travel and zoom without the top black strip; the Jammer housing stays fixed with gentle signal animation; illustrated rain-soaked blacktop fills below the existing curb.
implementation.layout: The rhythm lift moves to the middle-right Firewall canopy and the single broadcast terminal moves to the left entry route. Lift landing, boss pursuit target and right-side Jammer spawn clearance use the relocated layout.
implementation.preserved: Original car speed, art, warning timing, collision, sidewalk, rails, jump physics, hacking cooldowns, hijack duration, mission quota, boss rules, upper routes and the single-terminal/single-lift design remain.

verification.lockedRequirementsPreserved: Single-jump movement, 20-defeat mission, 16-hit Jammer, eight-second hijack, original four playable characters, music ownership, boss flow, Makko compatibility and all earlier retained requirements remain in the exact source tree.

automatedTests: npm test passed on the exact reviewed tree
npm run check:syntax:all passed on the exact reviewed tree
published review tree matched the tested local tree
reviewEvidence.focusedCoverage: Production input/player updates covered shared Cross contexts, held transitions, remaps and saved-layout migration; hack-popup lifecycle; D-pad, stick, keyboard and Rhythm-Mode platform drops; lower-platform landing, no held repeat, solid street, pause/reset and moving-lift release; sky bounds at four zooms and two camera heights; and fixed Jammer anchoring.
reviewEvidence.trajectoryRates: Focused traversal and input checks covered 30, 60 and 120Hz.
reviewEvidence.nativeReview: Eight production-Canvas previews covering controls, popup states, relocated routes, wet street, sky and Jammer presentation are committed under docs/source-pack/verification. Adapted image/Makko boundaries are not hosted acceptance.

Then walk the long route, rooftops and boss flow. Record imported SHA, PASS/FAIL and clips.
